layout: summary + report header + one case file per case + run-log + journal-common + one journal file per read frame + cursor-pixels (retained controlled PNGs)
note: Pinned terminfo.dev@4.0.0 cases cursor.cup-scroll-region, cursor.hide, cursor.shape and cursor.reverse-wrap, graded by the twenty-first layered collector extension (ntilde-owned-cursor-qualification-grading-v1, contracts v1). The pinned verdicts of the three app callbacks that cannot decide (cup-scroll-region, hide, shape) are inconclusive by design and preserved; the termless callbacks and the contract are reported beside them. cursor.reverse-wrap and cursor.shape run through the geometry-repaired derivation ntilde-owned-cursor-geometry-repair-v1 with their original UndeclaredTerminalGeometry failures retained. Stored state, physical cursor, raw CPR exchanges and controlled synthetic-phase (0 ms / 530 ms) offscreen renders only; no desktop blink cadence, focus or stock grade is claimed.

stockCollector.note: Stock cursor.cup-scroll-region, cursor.hide and cursor.shape are inconclusive and stock cursor.reverse-wrap is an ungraded UndeclaredTerminalGeometry collector error (suiteComplete=false); all unchanged by this run. The stock hide and shape app callbacks end inconclusive because the owned stock run supplies no capture adapter.

retained.note: git-ignored local artifacts/terminfo/owned-dBLb3k (this run), owned-Y0M3oi (the superseded first run on the fixed App) and owned-EP3tVI (before the fix) in the ntilde-cursor-qualification-d955e0 worktree; the publication here carries the complete journal, run log and every controlled PNG of this run.

attempts.note: The first launch (App from main bd802f67) exited SIGABRT at startup: Avalonia.Native could not start the render timer (error -6661) because the display was asleep. Nothing was collected; the directory was discarded. The collector now runs under caffeinate -u/-d.

All four cases supported. Superseded when Codex review found that the DECOM control rows (20;3, 20;5) cannot fit the accepted 15-19 row geometries, that the hidden blink phase did not check the unrelated pixels, and that retained captures were not revalidated for their state bracket and shared render context. The three controls/checks changed, so the measurement was repeated; the verdicts were identical.
